definitions.gloss: an extra, clinching point or goal
definitions.explanation: In sports, a further score added when the win is already nearly certain, which puts the result beyond doubt.

definitions.gloss: making doubly sure; a final push
definitions.explanation: Doing or saying something once more to make sure of a result that is already almost certain.

examples.japanese: {駄目押|だめお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一点|いってん}→一点：08894_itten⟧。
{九回|きゅうかい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駄目押|だめお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホームラン→ホームラン：20814_hoomuran⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}た→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: A clinching home run came in the ninth inning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{後半|こうはん}→後半：12555_kouhan⟧⟦{終了|しゅうりょう}→終了：02563_shuuryou⟧⟦{間際|まぎわ}→間際：14564_magiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駄目押|だめお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めて→決める：00858_kimeru⟧、{三対|さんたい}⟦{零|れい}→零：00983_rei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧。
examples.english: They scored a clinching goal just before the end of the second half and won three to nothing.

examples.english: I phoned just to make doubly sure.

examples.english: The weak yen on top of the price rises was the final blow, and customers stayed away even more.

notes:
From the game of go: filling the last neutral points ({駄目|だめ}) after the game is decided, to confirm the count. Often written ダメ{押|お}し.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駄目押|だめお}し⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一点|いってん}→一点：08894_itten⟧ / ⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧: a clinching run / goal
- {駄目押|だめお}し⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to make doubly sure
- {駄目押|だめお}し⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to clinch it; to be the final blow
